description: Circular imports currently connect src/holon_coherence/commands/docker_ops.py and src/holon_coherence/commands/endpoints.py (docker_ops.py deferred-imports endpoints while endpoints.py imports container probes from docker_ops.py).
goal: Break the circular import between src/holon_coherence/commands/docker_ops.py and src/holon_coherence/commands/endpoints.py so imports flow strictly one way (docker_ops.py -> endpoints.py, with endpoints.py having zero imports from docker_ops.py) by moving the low-level container inspection helpers used by endpoints (is_container_running, get_container_mapped_port, get_container_web_token, and any small private helpers they need) into src/holon_coherence/commands/endpoints.py and re-exporting them from src/holon_coherence/commands/docker_ops.py so all existing callers, CLI exports, and monkeypatches in tests/test_cli.py and tests/commands/test_docker_ops.py remain 100% backward-compatible. Keep both modules strictly within their line budgets (endpoints.py <= 200 lines, docker_ops.py <= 221 lines), create zero new Python files, and do NOT modify tests/test_import_cycle_ratchet.py, src/holon_coherence/commands/web_token.py, or holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json. Add an AST acyclic-import test in tests/commands/test_endpoints.py asserting that commands/endpoints.py has zero imports from commands/docker_ops.py and verify existing behavior in tests/commands/test_docker_ops.py and tests/commands/test_endpoints.py. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Eliminating the commands/docker_ops.py <-> commands/endpoints.py cycle removes deferred runtime imports and completes the commands-package acyclic boundary cleanly without overlapping open PRs.
acceptance_criteria: Zero circular imports remain between src/holon_coherence/commands/docker_ops.py and src/holon_coherence/commands/endpoints.py (endpoints.py has zero imports from docker_ops.py, verified by an AST test in tests/commands/test_endpoints.py).

All existing callers and re-exports on src/holon_coherence/commands/docker_ops.py (including handle_status, is_container_running, get_container_mapped_port, get_container_web_token) remain backward-compatible and tested in tests/commands/test_docker_ops.py and tests/commands/test_endpoints.py.

All changes stay within the 4 declared files (<= 200 lines for endpoints.py, <= 221 lines for docker_ops.py; zero new files; holon-config/hygiene/module_budgets.json and tests/test_import_cycle_ratchet.py untouched), uv run pytest and uv run task lint pass, and code is self-explaining (no docstrings; only '# why:' comments).
